info.title: API.SH: HotPads
info.description: The HotPads API from API.SH: public HotPads data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A HotPads place (city, neighborhood, county, ZIP): id, name, type, city, county, state, link, region id, center, map bounds and parent areas, plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotpads-area

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Place id such as austin-tx, a hotpads.com search link, or a name such as "Austin, TX".

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Places and buildings that match typed text on HotPads: cities, neighborhoods, boroughs, counties, ZIP codes, schools, addresses and listings, each with type, id (use it as location in the other HotPads endpoints), label, city, county, state and link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotpads-autocomplete

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The costs a rental lists on HotPads: estimated move-in total, estimated monthly total and base rent ranges, then every one-time and monthly fee (required and optional groups: admin, application, deposits, pet fees, parking, utilities...) with amount range, count and notes, plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotpads-fees

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (id of a search result, e.g. wcw1qx).

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: Or the listing alias (alias of a search result).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One rental on HotPads: title, property and rental type, full description, lease terms, special offer, unit count, office hours, rent/bedroom/bathroom/size ranges, total-monthly-price note, address, coordinates, neighborhood and breadcrumbs, every photo, amenities (building and unit), pet policies with fees and limits, floor plans with their units (size, price, availability, price drops), tags, income-restriction info, the managing company (private landlords with the contact name shown, no phone), views and inquiries, created/activated/updated dates and similar rentals, plus `raw` with the site's record. `latest=true` takes the first result of a search instead of an id.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotpads-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (id of a search result, e.g. wcw1qx).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Or a hotpads.com listing or building link.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: A unit name within the building (optional).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Use the first result of a search (pass the search params, e.g. location).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
How many rental units fall in each rent band in an area on HotPads (the site's price histogram), with the same filters as /hotpads/v1/search: unit count and, per band, min, max, count and percent.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotpads-rent-distribution

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City, neighborhood, county or ZIP: a HotPads place id such as austin-tx, 78704 or georgian-acres-austin-tx (as in id of /hotpads/v1/autocomplete), a hotpads.com search link, or a name such as "Austin, TX". Not needed with a map box.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Property types, comma list: apartment, condo, house, townhouse, duplex (default: all).

parameters.name: listing_type
parameters.description: Rental types, comma list: rental (regular), room, sublet, corporate (default: all).

parameters.name: pets
parameters.description: Pets allowed, comma list: cats, dogs.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Amenities, comma list: cooling, heating, parking, dishwasher, gym, pool, gated_entry, doorman.

parameters.name: restriction
parameters.description: Only income-restricted, senior, student or military housing.

parameters.name: by_owner
parameters.description: Only rentals the site marks as listed by owner.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Keywords in the listing (e.g. hardwood, balcony).

parameters.name: min_lat
parameters.description: Map box instead of location: south latitude (with max_lat, min_lon, max_lon).

parameters.name: bucket_size
parameters.description: Band width in USD (50 to 5000, default 250).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Apartments, houses, condos, townhomes and rooms for rent in the US on HotPads, with the site's filters: place or map box, bedrooms, bathrooms, rent, size, property and rental types, pets, laundry, amenities, furnished, income/senior/student/military housing, listed by owner and keywords, plus sort. Each result has the listing id and alias, link, title, property and rental type, rent range, bedroom/bathroom/size ranges, per-bedroom price models, address, coordinates, neighborhoods, photos, special-offer and housing-program flags, highlighted amenities, tags and the managing company (company name, contact and phone; private landlords with the contact name shown, no phone). `total` is the number of matching buildings and listings; `units_total` the number of units. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotpads-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
